Its AI empowers doctors to deliver faster, more accurate, and more compassionate care. Serving 500K+ patients across California, Rhode Island, and New York, Akido offers primary and specialty care in 26 specialties—from serving unhoused communities in Los Angeles to ride-share drivers in New York. We’re looking for a Physician (MD or DO) who believes that health starts with lifestyle and relationships — not just prescriptions. This role is for a physician who wants to blend clinical care with hands-on program design, patient connection, and health education. This isn’t a typical primary care role. This is a zero-to-one opportunity. We’re looking for a physician who’s energized by ambiguity, excited to experiment, and motivated to help turn a promising pilot into a scalable, sustainable model for underserved communities. This program is grounded in evidence and is designed to prevent and manage chronic conditions such as obesity, pre-diabetes, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia, while also addressing mental, social, and environmental drivers of health. If you’re passionate about community health, behavior change, and building something from the ground up — this is your opportunity to help reimagine primary care from the ground up.
